name: Meikko 3
source:
One day all of a sudden, "big sister" absconds.
The younger girls are now looked after by "big brother" uncle.
While he takes care of them he meets a runaway named Tamae.
They get along day by day, but what does the future hold?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ131449.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation: 某天，“姐姐”突然离家出走。年幼的女孩们如今由“哥哥”叔叔照顾。照顾她们期间，他遇见了一名离家出走的女孩，名叫玉枝。他们的关系日渐亲近，未来又会如何发展？[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ131449.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
